page.overview:
Who is Luche Lazarus?

Luche Lazarus is a character in Kingsglaive: Final Fantasy XV and a member of the eponymous Kingsglaive. He considers himself the group's leader.

Luche is a young man with slicked back brown hair and blue eyes. He wears the black uniform typical of his fellow Glaives and bears a pauldron during missions.

Luche proclaims himself the leader of the Glaives and acts as a second-in-command to Nyx Ulric when Titus Drautos goes missing. Luche's true nature is that of a traitorous, power-hungry individual with a resentment towards King Regis's decision to surrender the Lucian outlands to the empire.

Luche came to Insomnia as a refugee, and was admitted to the Kingsglaive. He guides his fellow Glaives as they fight Niflheim and Tenebrae's forces on the outskirts of Lucis. He reports to Titus Drautos after the enemy withdraws, and returns to Insomnia. He joins Crowe Altius, Libertus Ostium, Pelna Khara, and Nyx Ulric for a drink. As his comrades tease Nyx, Luche reveals Niflheim has sent an envoy to demand Lucis's surrender.
